body:
Karolis (31 Oct): level-3 yards need more room (Non-living layout: back fence at z -35).
Hedges move from 26.6 to 37.5 m off the lane road (2.5 m behind the new level-3 fence). Lots stay 13.2 m wide (neighbours).
Game code (js/02-world.js): laneRoad hedge z s*26.6 -> s*37.5; L.laneC z 26.15 -> 37.05 (both sides); lane-end hedge length 54.1 -> 75.9; laneFree 31.5 -> 42 so the forest keeps clear (hills start at 44, nothing to move).
js/05-map.js map lines: 26.6 -> 37.5, 27 -> 38; mapTrees 31.5 -> 42.
Shown in the Area plan (book copy of the town code, marked PLANNED). Trees on the new strip are deleted in the scene.

comments.text: Asked by Karolis in the Map chat, 31 Oct.
Approved: you decided it in chat (31 Oct). Deeper: 37.5 m so the level-3 yard can reach z -35.

short: Friends Lane hedges move out from 26.6 m to 37.5 m; level-3 yard to z -35.
title: Friends Lane: wider green border so level-3 backyards fit
